notes: Grounding validator cases (LLD §4.4). words are [w, start_ms, end_ms, conf]; a token is low-confidence when conf < low_conf. expected spans are [start, end] after any off-by-few repair, or "fallback" when the metrics fallback replaces the item. better_versions entries are [start, end, kept upgraded words]. dropped counts every model item removed (glow, grow, better versions, mistakes); in self_harm cases coaching is suppressed and dropped reflects only grounding failures.
